environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed as a Kubernetes pod in the 'auth-system' namespace. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service on port 8080. No service mesh is configured. All pods in the cluster can reach the service directly via DNS (auth-service.auth-system.svc.cluster.local:8080). Network policies are not enforced (CNI plugin is basic flannel without NetworkPolicy support). The pod runs with default resource limits and no sidecar proxies.
